prompt_lock:
CRITICAL HIGHEST PRIORITY: The product reference image is the EXACT basis for the product.
You MUST use the reference image as the EXACT basis for the product.
Keep EXACT same: silhouette and overall proportions, surface colour and finish, the position and count of every dark or differently-coloured section, lid / closure structure, and material texture.
DO NOT change: the shape, the colour blocks or their boundaries, the number of visible parts, or the surface finish.
You may ONLY change: background scene, camera angle, lighting, shadows.
The product must look IDENTICAL to the reference image.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: NO handle, NO side grip, NO carrying handle, NO strap, NO loop.
NO spout, NO pouring lip, NO straw, NO straw lid, NO second cap, NO flip top.
Preserve the exact height-to-diameter ratio; do not make it shorter, wider, taller or slimmer.
Do not add, remove, merge or recolour any section, ring or layer of the lid or body.
NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logo, NO brand mark, NO engraving, NO label, NO tag, NO barcode.
Do not substitute a similar-looking item; this is the exact item from the reference.
prompt_scene: Place that exact flask into a clean bright modern kitchen counter scene: light grey stone countertop, pale wall, soft natural daylight from the front left, generous empty space, centred composition, square 1:1 framing, high-end product photography lighting.
